blogs.title: Installation Ceremony of Rotaract Club of Government Model Engineering College, Kochi
blogs.author: Rotaract Club MEC
blogs.content:
# Installation Ceremony of Rotaract Club of Government Model Engineering College, Kochi

What began as an idea to bring together passionate students with a vision for service has now become a reality.

The official Installation Ceremony of the Rotaract Club of Government Model Engineering College, Kochi was successfully conducted on 16 May 2026 at the Internal Auditorium in the presence of distinguished guests, faculty members, and enthusiastic students.

The ceremony marked the beginning of a new journey focused on leadership, innovation, fellowship, and community service. Inspiring talks, the presentation of the club charter, and the installation of members highlighted the spirit of teamwork and commitment towards creating meaningful impact.

The event reflected the collective enthusiasm of students who aspire to serve society while growing as leaders. It laid the foundation for future projects, collaborations, and initiatives that will positively influence both the campus and the wider community.

Here's to building a club that dreams big, serves wholeheartedly, and creates change together.
blogs.excerpt: The official installation of the Rotaract Club of Government Model Engineering College marked the beginning of a journey focused on leadership, fellowship, innovation, and community service.

blogs.title: Praathal: Serving Hope, One Breakfast at a Time
blogs.author: Rotaract Club of Government Model Engineering College, Kochi
blogs.content:
# Praathal: Serving Hope, One Breakfast at a Time

**Date:** 21 May 2026
**Time:** 7:00 AM
**Venue:** Government Medical College Hospital, Kalamassery

The Rotaract Club of Government Model Engineering College, Kochi proudly participated in **Praathal**, a longstanding community service initiative organized by **Rotary Cochin Metropolis** on **21 May 2026** at the Government Medical College Hospital, Kalamassery.

Praathal is a heartfelt initiative dedicated to providing breakfast and tea to patients and their caregivers at the hospital. For many families spending long hours by the bedside of their loved ones, a warm meal offers not only nourishment but also comfort and reassurance during challenging times.

Our members joined hands with the Rotary Cochin Metropolis team in serving meals and interacting with beneficiaries, experiencing firsthand the profound impact that small acts of kindness can have. The event was a reminder that meaningful service often begins with simple gestures carried out with compassion and sincerity.

We are deeply grateful to **Rotary Cochin Metropolis** for providing us with the opportunity to contribute to this remarkable initiative. Collaborating on projects like Praathal strengthens our commitment to community service and reinforces the values that define the spirit of Rotaract.

As Rotaractors, we continue to believe that every act of service, no matter how small, has the power to create lasting change. Praathal was more than a service activity; it was an experience that reminded us of our shared responsibility to support and uplift those around us.

**Service Above Self.**

blogs.title: A Day of Service, Smiles, and New Perspectives at Kusumagiri Autism School
blogs.author: Rotaract Club of Government Model Engineering College, Kochi
blogs.content:
# A Day of Service, Smiles, and New Perspectives at Kusumagiri Autism School

**Date:** 19 June 2026
**Venue:** Kusumagiri Autism School, Kakkanad

On **19 June 2026**, members of the Rotaract Club of Government Model Engineering College, Kochi had the privilege of joining **Rotary Cochin Metropolis** for a meaningful day of service at **Kusumagiri Autism School, Kakkanad**.

As part of the visit, a **Solar Water Purifier** was donated to the institution, contributing to a healthier and more sustainable environment for the students and staff. Along with the donation, goodies were distributed, and our members spent quality time interacting with the children, creating moments filled with warmth, laughter, and genuine connection.

For many of our newly inducted Rotaractors, this was their first visit to an autism school. The experience offered valuable insights into the importance of empathy, acceptance, and inclusion. Beyond service, it became an opportunity to learn, understand, and appreciate the unique strengths and perspectives of every individual.

The visit served as a powerful reminder that meaningful community service is built not only through contributions and donations but also through compassion, respect, and human connection. Every conversation, smile, and shared moment reinforced the values that define the spirit of Rotaract.

We extend our sincere gratitude to **Rotary Cochin Metropolis** and the dedicated staff of **Kusumagiri Autism School** for welcoming us and allowing us to be part of this inspiring initiative. Experiences like these continue to strengthen our commitment to creating an inclusive and compassionate community.

Some experiences do more than brighten a day. They transform perspectives, inspire empathy, and remind us that true service begins with understanding.

**Service Above Self.**
blogs.excerpt: Rotaract MEC, in collaboration with Rotary Cochin Metropolis, visited Kusumagiri Autism School, Kakkanad, donating a Solar Water Purifier, spending time with the students, and embracing the values of empathy, inclusion, and meaningful community service.

introductions.title: About Rotaract Club of MEC Kochi
introductions.vision: Empower youth to become changemakers. Build inclusive and sustainable communities. Create lasting impact through service and leadership.
introductions.mission: To provide opportunities for Model Engineering College students to develop leadership skills, professional capabilities, and personal integrity through community service, innovative teamwork, and international fellowship.
introductions.purpose: Rotaract Club of Government Model Engineering College, Kochi (Rotaract MEC) is a community-driven student organization. We bring together energetic students who want to develop their professional and leadership skills while making a real difference in the lives of people around us. Our activities span educational support, environment conservation, technical skill development, and community welfare, all while cultivating lifelong friendships.
introductions.history: Officially installed in 2026, the Rotaract Club of Model Engineering College (Rotaract MEC) was established to channel student potential into meaningful societal change. Our foundation rests on the pillars of fellowship, leadership, and hands-on service. Through impact-driven community outreach, tailored professional development initiatives, and collaborative projects, we empower members to become proactive changemakers and empathetic leaders. As we expand our reach and adapt to new challenges, the club continues to grow dynamically, always guided by the timeless Rotary motto, "Service Above Self."
